nodes.question: How does the automated system in the factory improve the efficiency of monitoring environmental impact?
nodes.answer: The automated system uses sensors to collect real-time data on energy consumption, water use, and waste management, which is analysed by artificial intelligence to monitor KPIs and provide immediate corrective feedback.
